name: Željana Zovko - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the European Union, of the Agreement establishing an association between the European Union and the Principality of Andorra and the Republic of San Marino respectively
part_text:
The European Parliament gives its view on a new agreement between the EU and two small neighbouring countries, Andorra and San Marino. The deal would replace old customs arrangements and give them access to the EU's single market, similar to Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway. In return, they must follow EU rules, including on money laundering and tax transparency. The Parliament welcomes the deal but asks for close monitoring, support for their small administrations, and clear information for citizens.

- Andorra and San Marino join the EU single market and follow its rules.
- Businesses, workers and consumers in the EU and both countries.
- EU countries must now approve the deal before it takes effect.
